purpose: Defines an output contract for parallel agents that returns results via return values instead of shared files, eliminating write race conditions by design.
summary: Problem: concurrent writes by parallel agents to a shared file cause lost updates, with no file locking in Claude Code
Basic principle: agents return results as return values and the orchestrator holds them in main context
Scope: covers only the result hand-off path; writer agents editing their own scope and per-review data are out of scope
Collector agents never write deliverables; the orchestrator writes them once after integration
No intermediate files or session directories for passing results
Responsibilities of agents and orchestrator, including waiting for all agents and handling partial failure
Application example: existing code collection in start-requirements reverse-engineering
Anti-patterns: direct shared file writes, read-modify-write in agents, file locking, intermediate files
Checklist for designing new parallel agents
tasks: Designing a new skill that launches parallel agents
Reviewing orchestrator and agent output handling for race conditions
Deciding how agent results are passed to an orchestrator
Defining partial failure handling for parallel agents
title: DES-022 並列 agent 出力契約パターン 設計書
